1 Choose your Collin College program

What you’ll see: Programs are organized into two alphabetical sections. Transfer includes fields and areas of study designed primarily for transfer to a bachelor’s program. Workforce includes career-focused programs such as AAS degrees, certificates, and Collin College bachelor’s programs.

Some programs connect to more than one occupational direction.

2 Choose a job role

3 Search current opportunities

Opportunity Springboard launches searches on external job sites; Collin College does not control or endorse individual postings. Search results, filters, and job-board URL formats may change. For regulated professions, users are responsible for meeting applicable education, certification, licensing, and employer requirements.

My Saved Opportunities

Save promising job postings while you search, track whether you applied, and download the list to your device.

Saved jobs are stored in this browser on this device. Download your tracker as an Excel workbook if you want a portable copy. Job postings may expire or move, so saved links may stop working over time.
